prompt: Edit this educational two-panel rabbit illustration. Correct the BOOK GEOMETRY in BOTH panels using a physically consistent rectangular hardcover book. In LEFT panel book is resting on table, spine running from near viewer to far viewer along its LEFT edge from rabbit's viewpoint. Show front cover already swung almost completely OPEN TO THE LEFT, hovering just above table at about 15 degrees, while rabbit holds its far free outer corner. The inner surface of this opened cover must be blank white with a thin RED rim. The cover must have exactly the SAME height and width as EACH SINGLE white page beneath, just a tiny 2 mm overhang, all drawn in the same table perspective. Thus left panel shows two adjacent matching rectangular planes joined along one straight spine: opened front cover to LEFT and blank first page and complete page block to RIGHT. No large upright red slab, no striped exterior facing inside, no cover crossing diagonally across page block. Red exterior has one yellow diagonal stripe but it is mostly underside and hidden when open. RIGHT panel same rabbit reading the same book normally open, two equal-size blank pages with equal red cover rims. Book should retain EXACT same page size across panels relative to hands. Preserve rabbit identity, outfit, anatomy, chair and table, scale and camera angle. Remove black panel border rectangles, use broad white gutters and wide white outer margins. Entire rabbit ears paws feet tail and furniture visible. Clean flat colors and outlines, no text numerals arrows or marks.
